viewer: Workers in the 12% tax bracket who have a 401(k) but no emergency savings and just got a surprise $1,000 bill.
decision: Take a $1,000 emergency withdrawal from my 401(k), or put the bill on a credit card?
promise: Using decades of actual card interest rates, we find how long a card balance can linger before its interest outweighs the tax on the withdrawal.
title: $1,000 Emergency: Tap the 401(k) or Use the Card?
thumbnail: a credit card and a retirement piggy bank on a balance scale / "Which Costs Less?"
